decisions.reason: The bathroom-door relocation is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; no additional update or removal is required.
The Unit 3 counter-position change does not alter the three cabinet sets, open-plan configuration, or specified cabinet lengths.
The source concerns the Unit 3 bathroom door and does not change Unit 2 bathroom placement or partitioning.
Removing red-marked walls and constructing turquoise-marked walls were already established before this Event; the source applies that existing strategy without changing it.

The source asks whether the WC can be incorporated into Unit 1 using turquoise walls, but the WC location within Unit 1 is already established and no new confirmed fixture or plumbing rule is entailed.
The question about room size when the balcony is not incorporated does not change the existing conditional balcony-retention policy.
The detailed Unit 3 layout proposal does not change the required floor-plan deliverable, its acceptable format, or its required content categories.
The counter and bathroom-door changes do not alter the required subdivision into three dwellings.
The source does not change Unit 1's 2+1 configuration, bedroom count, or living-area count.
